data.review_body:
Absolutely not worth the hassle. My packages are now over two weeks late. Shein told me to contact the shipping company, but the shipping company said it was still within the delivery timeframe. After I sent them a screenshot proving it had already exceeded the promised timeframe twice, yes folks twice, they changed their story and admitted it was late.  

To make matters worse, the shipping company suddenly claimed my address was "unshippable"—even though they had already successfully delivered other packages to the exact same address. Then Shein turned around and canceled it, refunded the funds yet I was told by the shipping company it would be delivered the following day.  Which of course was untrue. Now they want 3 more days.  

I'm still waiting for my order with no real answers or resolution. Poor customer service, conflicting information, refusal to get a manager and zero accountability. I won't be ordering again. I highly recommend not going through the hassle especially if you want your items within the timeframe promised.

data.review_body:
I ordered $166.27 worth of merchandise from SHEIN and never received the items I actually purchased.

Instead, my package contained another customer’s order, including that customer’s packing slip with a different name and shipping address. The clothing I received did not match my order at all.

I immediately contacted SHEIN and submitted extensive evidence, including:

* Photos of the items I actually received.
* The other customer’s packing slip that was inside my package.
* My original order showing what I purchased.
* Additional documentation proving the merchandise did not match my order.

Despite this, SHEIN repeatedly denied my claim, stating that their warehouse confirmed my package was shipped correctly. They have never explained how another customer’s packing slip ended up inside my package if there was supposedly no fulfillment error.

Rather than acknowledging that I never received the merchandise I paid for, I was simply told to return the package as if this were a standard return.

I have since had to file a dispute with Klarna, a complaint with the Better Business Bureau, and a report with the FTC because I have been unable to get SHEIN to address the evidence or issue a refund.

My biggest frustration is not just the fulfillment mistake—mistakes happen. It’s that even after providing clear documentation, including another customer’s packing slip, SHEIN refused to explain how that could happen while insisting there was no warehouse error.

I expected much better customer service and accountability.
data.review_headline: Received Another Customer’s Order, Then SHEIN Denied It

data.review_body:
I have reviewed Shein about one week ago, but have just now received my latest package.

This has by far been my worst package. I ordered 3 manga-inspired pens, a japanese carpet (small) and a t-shirt (L).

The Three Pens:
I have had no issues with them. They were all great quality and looked stunning. It was a bit expensive for 3 pens though.

The  Carpet:
I hated it. It was horrible. The only good thing about it was the size. The carpet had a Koi carp / Japanese artwork on it. Which looked great on the photo's. But when it arrived, it had white patches that had no color. The carpet was also folded so badly that it can hardly be used as a carpet.

The T-Shirt:
It had a very fun and happy artwork on it. Other than that, awful. The color of the shirt was a disgusting yellow. Not the same as in the picture. Size L feels more like a size M and the fabric used is just terrible. It's extremely hot and looks like a wrinkled gym shirt.

I don't see myself ever buying clothing on Shein again, nor carpets. 2/5 stars.

The parcel has now been delivered, thank you for the  a company has responded to me   
SIhIN
Is good The shorts my husband likes them.
